name: Ice Quote Request Autoresponder Default
subjectTemplate: We received your ice rink rental request
htmlBodyTemplate:
Hi {{lead.fullName}},

Thanks for contacting IceSkatingRinkRentals.com. We received your quote request and will review the event details you shared.

Request summary
Event city/state: {{lead.eventCity}}, {{lead.eventState}}
Event date or range: {{lead.eventDateOrDateRange}}
Event type: {{lead.eventType}}
Venue setting: {{lead.venueSetting}}

Reference: {{formEntry.id}}

This message is a draft autoresponder template and should only be enabled after the email provider, DNS, consent policy, and sending approval are complete.

variables.lead.fullName: Submitter name from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventCity: Event city from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventState: Event state from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventDateOrDateRange: Event date/range from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventType: Event type from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.venueSetting: Venue setting from sanitized FormEntry formData.

notes: Draft and dry-run-only until provider selection and explicit approval.
Do not send if FormEntry consentAccepted is false.
Do not treat this autoresponder as proof that the lead was fulfilled.
